results.corrected_title: SpaceX Q3: AI unit revenue nearly triples, and SpaceX and Tesla boards set up committees to assess a merger
results.corrected_summary: SpaceX reported Q3 results on 20 October. Total revenue was 14.6 billion dollars, up 161 percent year over year. Its AI segment, Super Intelligence, brought in 7.56 billion dollars, up from 2.56 billion in Q2 and more than Connectivity/Starlink's 5.25 billion; the segment includes compute leased to Anthropic, Google, Grok and X. On the earnings call Elon Musk said the boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees of independent directors to review a possible merger. No terms have been agreed, and Musk says he cannot take part in the committees' discussions because he is a conflicted party.
key_facts: Q3 total revenue 14.6 billion dollars, up 161% year over year
Super Intelligence (AI) segment revenue 7.56 billion dollars, vs 2.56 billion in Q2
Connectivity (mostly Starlink) revenue 5.25 billion dollars, up 69%
Net income 4.4 billion dollars; operating income 2.79 billion dollars
SpaceX and Tesla boards each formed special committees of independent directors; no terms agreed
Musk said he is conflicted and cannot join the committee discussions
results.issues: No factual errors found. Starlink figure is SpaceX's Connectivity segment (mostly Starlink). NBC source was not opened. The revenue numbers come from Fortune and the merger committee details from TechCrunch.

results.corrected_title: Anthropic commits 5 percent of its shares to a new public benefit fund
results.corrected_summary: On 18 October Anthropic announced that, subject to stockholder approval, it will commit 5 percent of its shares to a new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund. The board may add 2 percent more for every 50 percent increase in company value above a set baseline. The baseline was not disclosed. The fund can make large donations to nonprofits, make direct distributions to specific groups such as workers hit by AI, and try bolder approaches to AI's effects on the labour market; it may not be used for lobbying or political giving. Together with the co-founders' 80 percent equity pledges and the employee donation match, about 20 percent of Anthropic's shares would go to public purposes.
key_facts: 5% of Anthropic shares committed to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, subject to stockholder approval
Board may add 2% for every 50% rise in value above a set baseline
No lobbying or political giving, in the US or abroad
About 20% of shares dedicated to public purposes when combined with co-founder pledges and employee match
Fund is set up as an LLC, which allows flexible forms of giving
results.issues: No errors found. The event falls on the first day of the window (2026-10-18).

results.corrected_title: Salesforce buys Braze for 5.66 billion dollars
results.corrected_summary: On 20 October Salesforce agreed to buy customer engagement platform Braze for about 5.66 billion dollars in enterprise value. Braze shareholders get 47.50 dollars per share in cash, about 58 percent above the prior close of 30.04 dollars. Braze's AI tools help marketers optimise content, offers and channels. The deal needs shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to close in Salesforce's fiscal 2028, which begins February 2027.
key_facts: Enterprise value about 5.66 billion dollars (per SEC-filed press release)
47.50 dollars per share in cash, about 58% premium over the 19 October close of 30.04 dollars
Expected to close in Salesforce fiscal 2028; no change to fiscal 2027 guidance
Braze shares rose about 50% after the announcement
Price is below Braze's 2021 IPO price of 65 dollars
results.issues: No errors found. The SEC 8-K URL and its enterprise-value wording come from a search result summary; the page itself was not opened. Bloomberg was not opened (paywall).
